> Hi, @ChinaniuIf MinerU alone finishes this PDF in 2-3 minutes, the extra time in RAGFlow is probably not from parsing itself, but from what happens after parsing. After MinerU returns the result, RAGFlow still needs to split the content into chunks, generate embeddings, and store them in the index.
Your document ends up with 3645 chunks, so these extra steps can take quite a while.
